research_question: Can a source-blind conservative edit to WSP131's confidence release, without more source observations or rewriting old weights, eliminate confident errors on one unseen-to-the-parent structural perturbation while retaining >=95% correct familiar causal predictions, and gain useful shear-world correct coverage rather than merely abstaining?
frozen_mechanism: Do not change existing WSP131 source law or learning. Extend source-blind hypothesis ledger AFTER the same 32 original causal consequences/world with all 720 variable permutations times all 30 one-bit GF2 shears (21,600 typed alternative hypotheses), in addition to 720 original pure permutations. Keep every hypothesis consistent with actually paid observations. At each withheld x only emit 0 or 1 if ALL surviving pure+shear programs agree, otherwise ABSTAIN. When no survivor, ABSTAIN. This is a bounded conservative confidence gate; ANF/GF2 and shear primitive are supplied, not invented. No learned numeric/source outcome changed.
mechanism_rationale: The 32 original observations eliminate a pure hypothesis in 28/32 unfamiliar worlds but 4 shear worlds still match some pure perm. The true GF2-shear mapping is among the extra 21600 alternatives; including it guarantees within-grammar no confident contradictions, possibly at price of prediction coverage. The gate must be scored against this cost.

repair_envelope.edits_after_first_result_allowed: Diagnostic exploratory only; preserve all original metrics and issue receipts; a later disjoint prospectively frozen source must test the preselected candidate
repair_envelope.source_registry_changes: Only independent new public synthetic source; original WSP131 generator/score remains byte-identical

new_disjoint_public.source: Distinct source-only permutation/shear assignment from sha256('WSP132|MAP|'+targetseed), same64 already learned WSP130 quartic/quintic original source laws; shear i,j chosen from 30 source-only pairs and rejected if transformed truth identical to any pure permutation truth table (same exclusion as WSP131). No candidate may see source labels. Each view 256 public typed inputs with new random opaque subject IDs sampled without replacement from seed*1000..seed*1000+999.

cohorts.warm: Exactly 64 older WSP130 public source laws warm trained with 128 paid calls/world/arm on old source (8192 total); freeze prior snapshots and forbid update while testing new worlds
cohorts.relabeled_transfer: First16 new-source known worlds have zero-source identity-relabel views seeds 167000..167015; 4096 full predictions, zero new effects

baseline: Original WSP131 numerical and independently implemented exact symbolic comparator on EXACT SAME 32 action+effect transcript, using WSP131 adaptive policy unmodified. Cached original frozen metrics stay intact. Use independent conservative exact symbolic enumerator for 22,320 alternatives using separate implementation, same transcripts, must be prediction-identical to numeric repaired model. Include no-update and strongest fixed symbolic comparator from original as context and report original baseline errors.

primary_gates.prospective_known: at least95% correct across14336 held, ZERO confident wrong, 100% old source world 256-input cold retention
primary_gates.prospective_negative: at most1% confident wrong across7168 held AND >=25% correct held coverage (1792/7168) on novel shear worlds, versus original safe fixed symbolic which correctly predicts0/7168 (all abstain). Zero errors with zero coverage does NOT qualify.
primary_gates.original_exposed: publish before and after numeric correct/wrong/abstain counts separately, never relabel original NO_GO
primary_gates.prospective_transfer: 4096/4096 correct on new opaque-ID labels of 16 known transformed laws, zero paid interventions
primary_gates.exact_symbolic: numeric and independently implemented symbolic repaired decisions bitwise identical for all withheld positive, negative and transfer events, or ENGINEERING_INVALID
primary_gates.retention: old64 WSP130 fully warm learned 256-input signatures and snapshots byte-identical after target learning, cold replay all target states, tampered masks rejected
primary_gates.cost: same32 paid actions/world for original and repaired arm; CPU/wall peak measured but whole process cost parity UNQUALIFIED

decision.success: DEVELOPMENT_REPAIR_SUPPORTED_ONLY if ALL prospective public source gates pass, no claim scientific pass or unique numeric advantage
decision.partial: DEVELOPMENT_REPAIR_PARTIAL if wrong confidence reduced but retained coverage or controls fail
decision.failure: DEVELOPMENT_REPAIR_NO_GO if either prospective gate fails or worse than original, preserve outcome without post hoc tuning
decision.invalid: Source leakage, target labels visible, action budget increase, source first-use, score change, matching symbolic control missing, archived WSP131 changed, G29 or final two OS regression incomplete
